title: Presentations should feel designed, not generated
takeaway: PPD treats presentation creation as a deliberate design process, not a template-filling task.
compositionBrief: A typography-led opening on a deep ink field. Use one oversized editorial headline, a restrained eyebrow, a short supporting line and a single accent rule. No stock imagery, decorative iconography, generic gradients or floating shapes.

A quality-first system for narrative, art direction and editable output.
